Holiday closures and one-off reschedules published by the providers are NOT subtracted - verify against the source map before a distribution date. Sites whose schedule was not published as a fixed pattern are in _deferred.

items.description: Community food program runs this free food distribution at Horizon Christian Fellowship Meal. Schedule: Every Sunday at 12:00 pm. All are welcome Hot meal service. Call ahead if you can - distributions often end early when supplies run out.

items.title: St. Bart's Church - Free Food Distribution
items.description: Feeding San Diego runs this free food distribution at St. Bart's Church. Schedule: Weekly. Bring your own bags. Call ahead if you can - distributions often end early when supplies run out.

items.title: Jewish Family Services of SD - Free Food Distribution
items.description: San Diego Food Bank runs this free food distribution at Jewish Family Services of SD. Schedule: 2nd Sunday of the month from 4:00 pm - 5:30 pm. EFAP income guidelines apply Drive-thru services. Call ahead if you can - distributions often end early when supplies run out.
